t: You're by the River Thames, next to the Millennium Bridge and opposite Tate Modern. This is City of London School, a private day school for boys. It is a partner of the City of London School for Girls and the City of London Freemen's School, and all three receive funding from the City's Cash. Its founder was John Carpenter, who lived from about 1372 to 1442. He was Town Clerk of London under Henry V and Henry VI, and he wrote Liber Albus, the first book of English common law.
